title: PySpark .show() fails with “Python worker exited unexpectedly” on Windows (Python 3.14)
question:
Body

answer:
Likely solution:
Downgrade to python version 3.11 (or older).

Context:
Assuming you have everything set up correctly, You are most likely running into this issue. In short there is a bug that causes pyspark to crash on windows when using python version 3.12 or higher.

For more details see this related question about Windows and Pyspark
